name: Endless Journey - Of Cherished Memories and a New Voyage: Travelers' Stories
description: Another world, seven nations, all life The story of Genshin Impact begins with a journey For the past two years, countless Travelers have had memorable adventures in Teyvat. On this special occasion, we invite you to relive these unforgettable travel memories together. Let's remember the past to move forward into the future! Share your Genshin Impact memories and stories!
